heading.title: Of Contracts, Voidable Contracts and Void Agreements

article.title: Contract caused by mistake of one party as to matter of fact.
article.content:
22Contract caused by mistake of one party as to matter of fact.

Section 22  ·  Chapter II  ·  page 16 of the Act
A contract is not voidable merely because it was caused by one of the parties to it being under a mistake as to a matter of fact.
